::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
One of the earliest and largest semiconductor design operations in India. Hyderabad is Qualcomm's largest engineering centre outside San Diego.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Snapdragon mobile SoCs, 5G modem chipsets, AI/ML inference engines, and automotive connectivity chips. India teams contribute across the full design cycle — architecture, RTL, verification, physical design, and software.
